title: Codewars 7kyu: Disemvowel Trolls
description: Trolls are attacking your comment section! A common way to deal with this situation is to remove all of the vowels from the trolls' comments, neutralizing the threat. Return a new string with all vowels (a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive) removed.

input.string_: This website is for losers LOL!

visible_tests.expected: Ths wbst s fr lsrs LL!

input.string_: No offense but,\nYour writing is among the worst I've ever read

visible_tests.expected: N ffns bt,\nYr wrtng s mng th wrst 'v vr rd

explanation: Filters characters not belonging to the vowel set in O(N) time.
